item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Sprout Lunch Menu: A selection of fresh seasonal vegetables that you can combine with a protein of your choice to create your own meal salad.

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Homebound Lunch Menu: Danish leek and potato tart on a crisp wholegrain base with caramelised leek, thyme, potato and cheese, topped with roasted sunflower seeds. With a crisp pointed-cabbage salad with Danish apple and mustard vinaigrette and pickled gherkins. Also served gluten free and vegan. (1+2+6+11+13)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 - Globetrotter Lunch Menu: Indian dal makhani – a creamy, slow-simmered stew of black beluga lentils, kidney beans, tomato, ginger and garam masala, served with steamed basmati rice and topped with namkeen. With warm naan bread, mint raita, mango chutney and coriander. Also served gluten free and vegan. (1+6+9+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB3 - Lunch Menu: Aloo palak – potatoes and spinach in an intense sauce made with warmth and generous Nepalese love, served with rice and raita. (7+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB2 - Lunch Menu: Chickpea tikka masala served with rice. (7+8+13+15)

item.title: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu:
item.description: 🍽 HUB1 – Kays - Lunch Menu: Lemon- and herb-roasted cauliflower and chickpeas served with a warm quinoa salad with vegetables, bulgur and baby spinach, topped with roasted seeds with za'atar. With tahini-garlic yoghurt, a fresh herb salad of dill, mint, parsley and radish, home-marinated olives and chilli sauce. Also served gluten free and vegan. (1+6+8+13+15)
